--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\Pages\Manage\Index.razor ---
@page "/Account/Manage"

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using DocumEntum.Data
@using DocumEntum.Services
@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager
@inject SignInManager<ApplicationUser> SignInManager
@inject IdentityUserAccessor UserAccessor
@inject ICurrentUserService CurrentUserService
@inject IOrganizationService OrgService

<PageTitle>Мой профиль</PageTitle>

<h3>Профиль пользователя</h3>

<StatusMessage Message="@statusMessage" />

<div class="row">
    <div class="col-md-6">
        <table class="table">
            <tr>
                <th>Логин</th>
                <td>@username</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <th>Email</th>
                <td>@email</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <th>Полное имя</th>
                <td>@(fullName ?? "—")</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <th>Роль</th>
                <td>@roleName</td>
            </tr>
            @if (isEmployee)
            {
                <tr>
                    <th>Отдел</th>
                    <td>@departmentName</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <th>Должность</th>
                    <td>@positionTitle</td>
                </tr>
            }
        </table>

        <form action="Account/Logout" method="post">
            <AntiforgeryToken />
            <input type="hidden" name="ReturnUrl" value="/" />
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger">Выйти</button>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private string? statusMessage;
    private string? username;
    private string? email;
    private string? roleName;
    private string? fullName;
    private bool isEmployee;
    private string? departmentName;
    private string? positionTitle;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var user = await UserAccessor.GetRequiredUserAsync(HttpContext);
        username = user.UserName;
        email = user.Email ?? "не указан";
        var roles = await UserManager.GetRolesAsync(user);
        var roleEn = roles.FirstOrDefault() ?? "Нет роли";
        roleName = TranslateRole(roleEn);
        isEmployee = roleEn == "Employee";

        if (isEmployee)
        {
            var emp = await CurrentUserService.GetCurrentEmployeeAsync();
            fullName = emp?.FullName;
            if (emp != null)
            {
                var positions = await CurrentUserService.GetCurrentPositionsAsync();
                var firstPos = positions.FirstOrDefault();
                if (firstPos?.Position != null)
                {
                    departmentName = firstPos.Position.Department?.Name ?? "Не указан";
                    positionTitle = firstPos.Position.Title;
                }
                else
                {
                    departmentName = "Не назначен";
                    positionTitle = "Не назначена";
                }
            }
            else
            {
                departmentName = "Сотрудник не найден";
                positionTitle = "Сотрудник не найден";
            }
        }
    }

    private string TranslateRole(string roleEn) => roleEn switch
    {
        "Admin" => "Администратор",
        "Employee" => "Сотрудник",
        "SuperAdmin" => "Главный администратор",
        _ => roleEn
    };
}

--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\Pages\ConfirmEmail.razor ---
@page "/Account/ConfirmEmail"

@using System.Text
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities
@using DocumEntum.Data

@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager
@inject IdentityRedirectManager RedirectManager

<PageTitle>Confirm email</PageTitle>

<h1>Confirm email</h1>
<StatusMessage Message="@statusMessage" />

@code {
    private string? statusMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? UserId { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Code { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (UserId is null || Code is null)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("");
        }

        var user = await UserManager.FindByIdAsync(UserId);
        if (user is null)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            statusMessage = $"Error loading user with ID {UserId}";
        }
        else
        {
            var code = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(WebEncoders.Base64UrlDecode(Code));
            var result = await UserManager.ConfirmEmailAsync(user, code);
            statusMessage = result.Succeeded ? "Thank you for confirming your email." : "Error confirming your email.";
        }
    }
}


--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\Pages\ConfirmEmailChange.razor ---
@page "/Account/ConfirmEmailChange"

@using System.Text
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities
@using DocumEntum.Data

@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager
@inject SignInManager<ApplicationUser> SignInManager
@inject IdentityRedirectManager RedirectManager

<PageTitle>Confirm email change</PageTitle>

<h1>Confirm email change</h1>

<StatusMessage Message="@message" />

@code {
    private string? message;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? UserId { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Email { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Code { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (UserId is null || Email is null || Code is null)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectToWithStatus(
                "Account/Login", "Error: Invalid email change confirmation link.", HttpContext);
        }

        var user = await UserManager.FindByIdAsync(UserId);
        if (user is null)
        {
            message = "Unable to find user with Id '{userId}'";
            return;
        }

        var code = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(WebEncoders.Base64UrlDecode(Code));
        var result = await UserManager.ChangeEmailAsync(user, Email, code);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            message = "Error changing email.";
            return;
        }

        // In our UI email and user name are one and the same, so when we update the email
        // we need to update the user name.
        var setUserNameResult = await UserManager.SetUserNameAsync(user, Email);
        if (!setUserNameResult.Succeeded)
        {
            message = "Error changing user name.";
            return;
        }

        await SignInManager.RefreshSignInAsync(user);
        message = "Thank you for confirming your email change.";
    }
}


--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\Pages\ExternalLogin.razor ---
@page "/Account/ExternalLogin"

@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using System.Security.Claims
@using System.Text
@using System.Text.Encodings.Web
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities
@using DocumEntum.Data

@inject SignInManager<ApplicationUser> SignInManager
@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager
@inject IUserStore<ApplicationUser> UserStore
@inject IEmailSender<ApplicationUser> EmailSender
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@inject IdentityRedirectManager RedirectManager
@inject ILogger<ExternalLogin> Logger

<PageTitle>Register</PageTitle>

<StatusMessage Message="@message" />
<h1>Register</h1>
<h2>Associate your @ProviderDisplayName account.</h2>
<hr />

<div  class="alert alert-info">
    You've successfully authenticated with <strong>@ProviderDisplayName</strong>.
    Please enter an email address for this site below and click the Register button to finish
    logging in.
</div>

<div class="row">
    <div class="col-md-4">
        <EditForm Model="Input" OnValidSubmit="OnValidSubmitAsync" FormName="confirmation" method="post">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <ValidationSummary class="text-danger" role="alert" />
            <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                <InputText @bind-Value="Input.Email" class="form-control" autocomplete="email" placeholder="Please enter your email." />
                <label for="email" class="form-label">Email</label>
                <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Email" />
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-100 btn btn-lg btn-primary">Register</button>
        </EditForm>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    public const string LoginCallbackAction = "LoginCallback";

    private string? message;
    private ExternalLoginInfo externalLoginInfo = default!;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? RemoteError { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Action { get; set; }

    private string? ProviderDisplayName => externalLoginInfo.ProviderDisplayName;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (RemoteError is not null)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectToWithStatus("Account/Login", $"Error from external provider: {RemoteError}", HttpContext);
        }

        var info = await SignInManager.GetExternalLoginInfoAsync();
        if (info is null)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectToWithStatus("Account/Login", "Error loading external login information.", HttpContext);
        }

        externalLoginInfo = info;

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            if (Action == LoginCallbackAction)
            {
                await OnLoginCallbackAsync();
                return;
            }

            // We should only reach this page via the login callback, so redirect back to
            // the login page if we get here some other way.
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/Login");
        }
    }

    private async Task OnLoginCallbackAsync()
    {
        // Sign in the user with this external login provider if the user already has a login.
        var result = await SignInManager.ExternalLoginSignInAsync(
            externalLoginInfo.LoginProvider,
            externalLoginInfo.ProviderKey,
            isPersistent: false,
            bypassTwoFactor: true);

        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation(
                "{Name} logged in with {LoginProvider} provider.",
                externalLoginInfo.Principal.Identity?.Name,
                externalLoginInfo.LoginProvider);
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo(ReturnUrl);
        }
        else if (result.IsLockedOut)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/Lockout");
        }

        // If the user does not have an account, then ask the user to create an account.
        if (externalLoginInfo.Principal.HasClaim(c => c.Type == ClaimTypes.Email))
        {
            Input.Email = externalLoginInfo.Principal.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.Email) ?? "";
        }
    }

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        var emailStore = GetEmailStore();
        var user = CreateUser();

        await UserStore.SetUserNameAsync(user, Input.Email, CancellationToken.None);
        await emailStore.SetEmailAsync(user, Input.Email, CancellationToken.None);

        var result = await UserManager.CreateAsync(user);
        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            result = await UserManager.AddLoginAsync(user, externalLoginInfo);
            if (result.Succeeded)
            {
                Logger.LogInformation("User created an account using {Name} provider.", externalLoginInfo.LoginProvider);

                var userId = await UserManager.GetUserIdAsync(user);
                var code = await UserManager.GenerateEmailConfirmationTokenAsync(user);
                code = WebEncoders.Base64UrlEncode(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(code));

                var callbackUrl = NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameters(
                    NavigationManager.ToAbsoluteUri("Account/ConfirmEmail").AbsoluteUri,
                    new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["userId"] = userId, ["code"] = code });
                await EmailSender.SendConfirmationLinkAsync(user, Input.Email, HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode(callbackUrl));

                // If account confirmation is required, we need to show the link if we don't have a real email sender
                if (UserManager.Options.SignIn.RequireConfirmedAccount)
                {
                    RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/RegisterConfirmation", new() { ["email"] = Input.Email });
                }

                await SignInManager.SignInAsync(user, isPersistent: false, externalLoginInfo.LoginProvider);
                RedirectManager.RedirectTo(ReturnUrl);
            }
        }

        message = $"Error: {string.Join(",", result.Errors.Select(error => error.Description))}";
    }

    private ApplicationUser CreateUser()
    {
        try
        {
            return Activator.CreateInstance<ApplicationUser>();
        }
        catch
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Can't create an instance of '{nameof(ApplicationUser)}'. " +
                $"Ensure that '{nameof(ApplicationUser)}' is not an abstract class and has a parameterless constructor");
        }
    }

    private IUserEmailStore<ApplicationUser> GetEmailStore()
    {
        if (!UserManager.SupportsUserEmail)
        {
            throw new NotSupportedException("The default UI requires a user store with email support.");
        }
        return (IUserEmailStore<ApplicationUser>)UserStore;
    }

    private sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required]
        [EmailAddress]
        public string Email { get; set; } = "";
    }
}


--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\Pages\ForgotPassword.razor ---
@page "/Account/ForgotPassword"

@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using System.Text
@using System.Text.Encodings.Web
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities
@using DocumEntum.Data

@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager
@inject IEmailSender<ApplicationUser> EmailSender
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@inject IdentityRedirectManager RedirectManager

<PageTitle>Forgot your password?</PageTitle>

<h1>Forgot your password?</h1>
<h2>Enter your email.</h2>
<hr />
<div class="row">
    <div class="col-md-4">
        <EditForm Model="Input" FormName="forgot-password" OnValidSubmit="OnValidSubmitAsync" method="post">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <ValidationSummary class="text-danger" role="alert" />

            <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                <InputText @bind-Value="Input.Email" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" aria-required="true" placeholder="name@example.com" />
                <label for="email" class="form-label">Email</label>
                <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Email" class="text-danger" />
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-100 btn btn-lg btn-primary">Reset password</button>
        </EditForm>
     </div>
</div>

@code {
    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        var user = await UserManager.FindByEmailAsync(Input.Email);
        if (user is null || !(await UserManager.IsEmailConfirmedAsync(user)))
        {
            // Don't reveal that the user does not exist or is not confirmed
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/ForgotPasswordConfirmation");
        }

        // For more information on how to enable account confirmation and password reset please
        // visit https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=532713
        var code = await UserManager.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(user);
        code = WebEncoders.Base64UrlEncode(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(code));
        var callbackUrl = NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameters(
            NavigationManager.ToAbsoluteUri("Account/ResetPassword").AbsoluteUri,
            new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = code });

        await EmailSender.SendPasswordResetLinkAsync(user, Input.Email, HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode(callbackUrl));

        RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/ForgotPasswordConfirmation");
    }

    private sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required]
        [EmailAddress]
        public string Email { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\Pages\Login.razor ---
@page "/Account/Login"

@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using DocumEntum.Data

@inject SignInManager<ApplicationUser> SignInManager
@inject ILogger<Login> Logger
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@inject IdentityRedirectManager RedirectManager

<PageTitle>Вход в систему</PageTitle>

<h1>Вход</h1>
<div class="row">
    <div class="col-md-4">
        <section>
            <StatusMessage Message="@errorMessage" />
            <EditForm Model="Input" method="post" OnValidSubmit="LoginUser" FormName="login">
                <DataAnnotationsValidator />
                <h2>Вход по логину и паролю</h2>
                <hr />
                <ValidationSummary class="text-danger" role="alert" />
                <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                    <InputText @bind-Value="Input.Login" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" aria-required="true" placeholder="login" />
                    <label for="login" class="form-label">Логин</label>
                    <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Login" class="text-danger" />
                </div>
                <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                    <InputText type="password" @bind-Value="Input.Password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password" aria-required="true" placeholder="password" />
                    <label for="password" class="form-label">Пароль</label>
                    <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Password" class="text-danger" />
                </div>
                <div class="checkbox mb-3">
                    <label class="form-label">
                        <InputCheckbox @bind-Value="Input.RememberMe" class="darker-border-checkbox form-check-input" />
                        Запомнить меня
                    </label>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <button type="submit" class="w-100 btn btn-lg btn-primary">Войти</button>
                </div>
            </EditForm>
        </section>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private string? errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(IdentityConstants.ExternalScheme);
        }
    }

    public async Task LoginUser()
    {
        var result = await SignInManager.PasswordSignInAsync(Input.Login, Input.Password, Input.RememberMe, lockoutOnFailure: false);
        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation("User logged in.");
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo(ReturnUrl);
        }
        else if (result.RequiresTwoFactor)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo(
                "Account/LoginWith2fa",
                new() { ["returnUrl"] = ReturnUrl, ["rememberMe"] = Input.RememberMe });
        }
        else if (result.IsLockedOut)
        {
            Logger.LogWarning("User account locked out.");
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/Lockout");
        }
        else
        {
            errorMessage = "Ошибка: неверный логин или пароль.";
        }
    }

    private sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Логин обязателен")]
        public string Login { get; set; } = "";

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Пароль обязателен")]
        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        public string Password { get; set; } = "";

        [Display(Name = "Запомнить меня?")]
        public bool RememberMe { get; set; }
    }
}

@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager

            <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                <InputText @bind-Value="Input.TwoFactorCode" class="form-control" autocomplete="off" />
                <label for="two-factor-code" class="form-label">Authenticator code</label>
                <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.TwoFactorCode" class="text-danger" />
            </div>
            <div class="checkbox mb-3">
                <label for="remember-machine" class="form-label">
                    <InputCheckbox @bind-Value="Input.RememberMachine" />
                    Remember this machine
                </label>
            </div>
            <div>
                <button type="submit" class="w-100 btn btn-lg btn-primary">Log in</button>
            </div>
        </EditForm>
    </div>

    Don't have access to your authenticator device? You can
    <a href="Account/LoginWithRecoveryCode?ReturnUrl=@ReturnUrl">log in with a recovery code</a>.

@code {
    private string? message;
    private ApplicationUser user = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private bool RememberMe { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // Ensure the user has gone through the username & password screen first
        user = await SignInManager.GetTwoFactorAuthenticationUserAsync() ??
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Unable to load two-factor authentication user.");
    }

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        var authenticatorCode = Input.TwoFactorCode!.Replace(" ", string.Empty).Replace("-", string.Empty);
        var result = await SignInManager.TwoFactorAuthenticatorSignInAsync(authenticatorCode, RememberMe, Input.RememberMachine);
        var userId = await UserManager.GetUserIdAsync(user);

        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation("User with ID '{UserId}' logged in with 2fa.", userId);
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo(ReturnUrl);
        }
        else if (result.IsLockedOut)
        {
            Logger.LogWarning("User with ID '{UserId}' account locked out.", userId);
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/Lockout");
        }
        else
        {
            Logger.LogWarning("Invalid authenticator code entered for user with ID '{UserId}'.", userId);
            message = "Error: Invalid authenticator code.";
        }
    }

    private sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required]
        [StringLength(7, ErrorMessage = "The {0} must be at least {2} and at max {1} characters long.", MinimumLength = 6)]
        [DataType(DataType.Text)]
        [Display(Name = "Authenticator code")]
        public string? TwoFactorCode { get; set; }

        [Display(Name = "Remember this machine")]
        public bool RememberMachine { get; set; }
    }
}

<h1>Resend email confirmation</h1>
<h2>Enter your email.</h2>
<hr />
<StatusMessage Message="@message" />
<div class="row">
    <div class="col-md-4">
        <EditForm Model="Input" FormName="resend-email-confirmation" OnValidSubmit="OnValidSubmitAsync" method="post">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <ValidationSummary class="text-danger" role="alert" />
            <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                <InputText @bind-Value="Input.Email" class="form-control" aria-required="true" placeholder="name@example.com" />
                <label for="email" class="form-label">Email</label>
                <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Email" class="text-danger" />
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-100 btn btn-lg btn-primary">Resend</button>
        </EditForm>
    </div>

@code {
    private string? message;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        var user = await UserManager.FindByEmailAsync(Input.Email!);
        if (user is null)
        {
            message = "Verification email sent. Please check your email.";
            return;
        }

        var userId = await UserManager.GetUserIdAsync(user);
        var code = await UserManager.GenerateEmailConfirmationTokenAsync(user);
        code = WebEncoders.Base64UrlEncode(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(code));
        var callbackUrl = NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameters(
            NavigationManager.ToAbsoluteUri("Account/ConfirmEmail").AbsoluteUri,
            new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["userId"] = userId, ["code"] = code });
        await EmailSender.SendConfirmationLinkAsync(user, Input.Email, HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode(callbackUrl));

        message = "Verification email sent. Please check your email.";
    }

    private sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required]
        [EmailAddress]
        public string Email { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

    private IEnumerable<IdentityError>? identityErrors;

    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    private string? Code { get; set; }

    private string? Message => identityErrors is null ? null : $"Error: {string.Join(", ", identityErrors.Select(error => error.Description))}";

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        if (Code is null)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/InvalidPasswordReset");
        }

        Input.Code = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(WebEncoders.Base64UrlDecode(Code));
    }

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        var user = await UserManager.FindByEmailAsync(Input.Email);
        if (user is null)
        {
            // Don't reveal that the user does not exist
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/ResetPasswordConfirmation");
        }

        var result = await UserManager.ResetPasswordAsync(user, Input.Code, Input.Password);
        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectTo("Account/ResetPasswordConfirmation");
        }

        identityErrors = result.Errors;
    }

    private sealed class InputModel
    {
        [Required]
        [EmailAddress]
        public string Email { get; set; } = "";

        [Compare("Password", ErrorMessage = "The password and confirmation password do not match.")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = "";

        [Required]
        public string Code { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations

@inject RoleManager<IdentityRole> RoleManager

<PageTitle>Создание главного администратора</PageTitle>

@if (checking)
{
    <p>Проверка...</p>

else if (SuperAdminStatus.HasSuperAdmin)
{
    // гл.админ уже существует в системе (создан в этой сессии или был при запуске)
    <p>Перенаправление...</p>

else
{
    <h2>Создание главного администратора</h2>
    <p>В системе нет гл.администратора. Пожалуйста, создайте его.</p>

            <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.UserName" class="text-danger" />
        </div>

        <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="form-label">Email (необязательно)</label>
            <InputText @bind-Value="Input.Email" type="email" class="form-control" />
            <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Email" class="text-danger" />
        </div>

        <div class="mb-3">

            <InputText @bind-Value="Input.Password" type="password" class="form-control" />
            <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.Password" class="text-danger" />
        </div>

        <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="form-label">Подтверждение пароля</label>
            <InputText @bind-Value="Input.ConfirmPassword" type="password" class="form-control" />
            <ValidationMessage For="() => Input.ConfirmPassword" class="text-danger" />
        </div>

        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Создать</button>
        @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorMessage))
        {
            <div class="alert alert-danger mt-3">@errorMessage</div>
        }
    </EditForm>
}

@code {
    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private InputModel Input { get; set; } = new();

    private string? errorMessage;
    private bool checking = true;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        checking = false;
        // Если гл.админ уже есть (флаг true)
        if (SuperAdminStatus.HasSuperAdmin)
        {
            NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/", true);
        }
    }

    private async Task HandleSubmit()
    {
        errorMessage = null;

        // проверяем флаг – на случай если страница открыта
        // гл.админ уже ксть
        if (SuperAdminStatus.HasSuperAdmin)
        {
            NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/");
            return;
        }

        var user = new ApplicationUser
        {
            UserName = Input.UserName,
            Email = string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.Email) ? null : Input.Email
        };

        var result = await UserManager.CreateAsync(user, Input.Password);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            errorMessage = string.Join(", ", result.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
            return;
        }

        var roleResult = await UserManager.AddToRoleAsync(user, "SuperAdmin");
        if (!roleResult.Succeeded)
        {
            errorMessage = string.Join(", ", roleResult.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
            await UserManager.DeleteAsync(user);
            return;
        }

        // Устанавливаем флаг, чтобы больше никогда не показывать эту страницу до перезапуска
        SuperAdminStatus.HasSuperAdmin = true;

        // Перенаправляем на страницу входа
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/Account/Login");
    }

    public class InputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Логин обязателен")]
        public string UserName { get; set; } = "";

        [EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "Некорректный email")]
        public string? Email { get; set; }

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Пароль обязателен")]
        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        [StringLength(100, MinimumLength = 6, ErrorMessage = "Пароль должен быть не менее 6 символов")]
        public string Password { get; set; } = "";

        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        [Compare("Password", ErrorMessage = "Пароли не совпадают")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = "";
    }
}

--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\IdentityComponentsEndpointRouteBuilderExtensions.cs ---
using DocumEntum.Components.Account.Pages;
using DocumEntum.Components.Account.Pages.Manage;
using DocumEntum.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Extensions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Primitives;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing
{
    internal static class IdentityComponentsEndpointRouteBuilderExtensions
    {
        // These endpoints are required by the Identity Razor components defined in the /Components/Account/Pages directory of this project.
        public static IEndpointConventionBuilder MapAdditionalIdentityEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(endpoints);

            var accountGroup = endpoints.MapGroup("/Account");

            accountGroup.MapPost("/PerformExternalLogin", (
                HttpContext context,
                [FromServices] SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager,
                [FromForm] string provider,
                [FromForm] string returnUrl) =>
            {
                IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, StringValues>> query = [
                    new("ReturnUrl", returnUrl),
                    new("Action", ExternalLogin.LoginCallbackAction)];

                var redirectUrl = UriHelper.BuildRelative(
                    context.Request.PathBase,
                    "/Account/ExternalLogin",
                    QueryString.Create(query));

                var properties = signInManager.ConfigureExternalAuthenticationProperties(provider, redirectUrl);
                return TypedResults.Challenge(properties, [provider]);
            });

            accountGroup.MapPost("/Logout", async (
                ClaimsPrincipal user,
                SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager,
                [FromForm] string returnUrl,
                HttpContext context) =>
            {
                await signInManager.SignOutAsync();

                // Функция для проверки локального URL
                static bool IsLocalUrl(string? url)
                {
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
                        return false;
                    // Пропускаем внешние URL
                    if (url.StartsWith("//") || url.StartsWith("/\\"))
                        return false;
                    // Разрешаем относительные пути, начинающиеся с "/"
                    return url.StartsWith('/');
                }

                var redirectUrl = IsLocalUrl(returnUrl) ? returnUrl : "/";
                return TypedResults.LocalRedirect(redirectUrl);
            });

            var manageGroup = accountGroup.MapGroup("/Manage").RequireAuthorization();


            var loggerFactory = endpoints.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILoggerFactory>();
            var downloadLogger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger("DownloadPersonalData");

            manageGroup.MapPost("/DownloadPersonalData", async (
                HttpContext context,
                [FromServices] UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager,
                [FromServices] AuthenticationStateProvider authenticationStateProvider) =>
            {
                var user = await userManager.GetUserAsync(context.User);
                if (user is null)
                {
                    return Results.NotFound($"Unable to load user with ID '{userManager.GetUserId(context.User)}'.");
                }

                var userId = await userManager.GetUserIdAsync(user);
                downloadLogger.LogInformation("User with ID '{UserId}' asked for their personal data.", userId);

                // Only include personal data for download
                var personalData = new Dictionary<string, string>();
                var personalDataProps = typeof(ApplicationUser).GetProperties().Where(
                    prop => Attribute.IsDefined(prop, typeof(PersonalDataAttribute)));
                foreach (var p in personalDataProps)
                {
                    personalData.Add(p.Name, p.GetValue(user)?.ToString() ?? "null");
                }

                var logins = await userManager.GetLoginsAsync(user);
                foreach (var l in logins)
                {
                    personalData.Add($"{l.LoginProvider} external login provider key", l.ProviderKey);
                }

                personalData.Add("Authenticator Key", (await userManager.GetAuthenticatorKeyAsync(user))!);
                var fileBytes = JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(personalData);

                context.Response.Headers.TryAdd("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=PersonalData.json");
                return TypedResults.File(fileBytes, contentType: "application/json", fileDownloadName: "PersonalData.json");
            });

            return accountGroup;
        }
    }
}

--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\IdentityRedirectManager.cs ---
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;

namespace DocumEntum.Components.Account
{
    internal sealed class IdentityRedirectManager(NavigationManager navigationManager)
    {
        public const string StatusCookieName = "Identity.StatusMessage";

        private static readonly CookieBuilder StatusCookieBuilder = new()
        {
            SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
            HttpOnly = true,
            IsEssential = true,
            MaxAge = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5),
        };

        [DoesNotReturn]
        public void RedirectTo(string? uri)
        {
            uri ??= "";

            // Prevent open redirects.
            if (!Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(uri, UriKind.Relative))
            {
                uri = navigationManager.ToBaseRelativePath(uri);
            }

            // During static rendering, NavigateTo throws a NavigationException which is handled by the framework as a redirect.
            // So as long as this is called from a statically rendered Identity component, the InvalidOperationException is never thrown.
            navigationManager.NavigateTo(uri);
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"{nameof(IdentityRedirectManager)} can only be used during static rendering.");
        }

        [DoesNotReturn]
        public void RedirectTo(string uri, Dictionary<string, object?> queryParameters)
        {
            var uriWithoutQuery = navigationManager.ToAbsoluteUri(uri).GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Path);
            var newUri = navigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameters(uriWithoutQuery, queryParameters);
            RedirectTo(newUri);
        }

        [DoesNotReturn]
        public void RedirectToWithStatus(string uri, string message, HttpContext context)
        {
            context.Response.Cookies.Append(StatusCookieName, message, StatusCookieBuilder.Build(context));
            RedirectTo(uri);
        }

        private string CurrentPath => navigationManager.ToAbsoluteUri(navigationManager.Uri).GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Path);

        [DoesNotReturn]
        public void RedirectToCurrentPage() => RedirectTo(CurrentPath);

        [DoesNotReturn]
        public void RedirectToCurrentPageWithStatus(string message, HttpContext context)
            => RedirectToWithStatus(CurrentPath, message, context);
    }
}

using DocumEntum.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;

namespace DocumEntum.Components.Account
{
    internal sealed class IdentityUserAccessor(UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager, IdentityRedirectManager redirectManager)
    {
        public async Task<ApplicationUser> GetRequiredUserAsync(HttpContext context)
        {
            var user = await userManager.GetUserAsync(context.User);

            if (user is null)
            {
                redirectManager.RedirectToWithStatus("Account/InvalidUser", $"Error: Unable to load user with ID '{userManager.GetUserId(context.User)}'.", context);
            }

            return user;
        }
    }
}


--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Account\PersistingRevalidatingAuthenticationStateProvider.cs ---
using DocumEntum.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Server;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace DocumEntum.Components.Account
{
    internal sealed class PersistingRevalidatingAuthenticationStateProvider : RevalidatingServerAuthenticationStateProvider
    {
        private readonly IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory;
        private readonly IdentityOptions options;

        public PersistingRevalidatingAuthenticationStateProvider(
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            IServiceScopeFactory serviceScopeFactory,
            IOptions<IdentityOptions> optionsAccessor)
            : base(loggerFactory)
        {
            scopeFactory = serviceScopeFactory;
            options = optionsAccessor.Value;
        }

        protected override TimeSpan RevalidationInterval => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30);

        protected override async Task<bool> ValidateAuthenticationStateAsync(
            AuthenticationState authenticationState, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();
            var userManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
            return await ValidateSecurityStampAsync(userManager, authenticationState.User);
        }

        private async Task<bool> ValidateSecurityStampAsync(UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager, ClaimsPrincipal principal)
        {
            var user = await userManager.GetUserAsync(principal);
            if (user is null) return false;
            if (!userManager.SupportsUserSecurityStamp) return true;
            var principalStamp = principal.FindFirstValue(options.ClaimsIdentity.SecurityStampClaimType);
            var userStamp = await userManager.GetSecurityStampAsync(user);
            return principalStamp == userStamp;
        }
    }
}

            documentTypes = await DocumentTypeService.GetAllAsync();
            allDepartments = await DocumentTypeService.GetAllDepartmentsAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)

            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
        finally

            isLoading = false;
        }

        editModel = new DocumentTypeEditModel();

        errorMessage = null;
    }

    private void OpenEditModal(DocumentType dt)
    {
        editingDocumentType = dt;
        editModel = new DocumentTypeEditModel
        {
            Name = dt.Name,
            Description = dt.Description,
            SelectedDepartmentIds = dt.AvailableDepartments.Select(d => d.Id).ToArray()
        };
        showModal = true;
        errorMessage = null;
    }

    private async Task SaveDocumentType()
    {
        try
        {
            if (editingDocumentType == null)
            {
                var newDt = new DocumentType
                {
                    Name = editModel.Name,
                    Description = editModel.Description
                };
                await DocumentTypeService.CreateAsync(newDt, editModel.SelectedDepartmentIds.ToList());
            }
            else
            {
                editingDocumentType.Name = editModel.Name;
                editingDocumentType.Description = editModel.Description;
                await DocumentTypeService.UpdateAsync(editingDocumentType, editModel.SelectedDepartmentIds.ToList());
            }
            await LoadData();
            CloseModal();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteDocumentType(DocumentType dt)
    {
        try
        {
            var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", $"Удалить тип документа '{dt.Name}'? Все связанные бизнес-процессы также будут удалены.");
            if (confirmed)
            {
                await DocumentTypeService.DeleteAsync(dt.Id);
                await LoadData();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private void CloseModal()
    {
        showModal = false;
        editingDocumentType = null;
        editModel = new DocumentTypeEditModel();
        errorMessage = null;
    }

@code {
    private List<UserViewModel> userViewModels = new();
    private bool showModal;
    private ApplicationUser? editingUser;
    private UserEditModel editModel = new();
    private List<string> allRoles = new();
    private List<string> availableRoles = new();
    private string? errorMessage;
    private string? loadError;
    private bool isLoading = true;

    private List<Department> departments = new();
    private List<Position> availablePositions = new();

    private class UserViewModel
    {
        public ApplicationUser User { get; set; } = null!;
        public string Role { get; set; } = "";
        public bool IsSuperAdmin => Role == "SuperAdmin";
        public string? DepartmentName { get; set; }
        public string? PositionName { get; set; }
        public string? FullName { get; set; }
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await LoadRolesAsync();
            await LoadDepartmentsAsync();
            await LoadUsersOptimizedAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            loadError = $"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadRolesAsync()
    {
        allRoles = await RoleManager.Roles.Select(r => r.Name!).ToListAsync();
        availableRoles = allRoles.Where(r => r != "SuperAdmin").ToList();
    }

    private async Task LoadDepartmentsAsync()
    {
        departments = await OrgService.GetAllDepartmentsFlatAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadUsersOptimizedAsync()
    {
        var users = await UserManager.Users.ToListAsync();

        var userRolesQuery = from ur in DbContext.UserRoles
                             join r in DbContext.Roles on ur.RoleId equals r.Id
                             select new { ur.UserId, RoleName = r.Name! };

        var userRolesList = await userRolesQuery.ToListAsync();
        var rolesDict = userRolesList
            .GroupBy(ur => ur.UserId)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().RoleName);

        var employeePositions = await DbContext.EmployeePositions
            .Include(ep => ep.Employee)
            .Include(ep => ep.Position)
                .ThenInclude(p => p.Department)
            .Where(ep => ep.EndDate == null)
            .ToListAsync();

        var userPositions = employeePositions.ToDictionary(ep => ep.Employee.UserId, ep => ep);

        userViewModels = users.Select(user =>
        {
            var role = rolesDict.GetValueOrDefault(user.Id, "");
            var pos = userPositions.GetValueOrDefault(user.Id);
            return new UserViewModel
            {
                User = user,
                Role = role,
                DepartmentName = pos?.Position?.Department?.Name,
                PositionName = pos?.Position?.Title,
                FullName = pos?.Employee?.FullName
            };
        }).ToList();
    }

    private async Task CreateUserAsync()
    {
        editingUser = null;
        editModel = new UserEditModel();
        availablePositions.Clear();
        showModal = true;
        errorMessage = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task EditUserAsync(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        if (await IsSuperAdmin(user))
        {
            errorMessage = "Редактирование главного администратора запрещено.";
            return;
        }

        editingUser = user;
        var roles = await UserManager.GetRolesAsync(user);
        var currentRole = roles.FirstOrDefault() ?? "";
        var employee = await DbContext.Employees.FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.UserId == user.Id);

        EmployeePosition? employeePosition = null;
        if (employee != null)
        {
            employeePosition = await DbContext.EmployeePositions
                .Include(ep => ep.Position)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ep => ep.EmployeeId == employee.Id && ep.EndDate == null);
        }

        editModel = new UserEditModel
        {
            UserName = user.UserName ?? "",
            Email = user.Email,
            Password = "",
            SelectedRole = currentRole,
            FullName = employee?.FullName ?? "",
            DepartmentId = employeePosition?.Position?.DepartmentId,
            PositionId = employeePosition?.PositionId
        };

        if (currentRole == "Employee" && editModel.DepartmentId.HasValue)
        {
            await LoadPositionsByDepartment(editModel.DepartmentId.Value);
        }
        else
        {
            availablePositions.Clear();
        }
        StateHasChanged();
        showModal = true;
        errorMessage = null;
    }

    private async Task OnRoleChanged()
    {
        var newRole = editModel.SelectedRole;
        if (newRole != "Employee")
        {
            editModel.DepartmentId = null;
            editModel.PositionId = null;
            availablePositions.Clear();
        }
        else
        {
            if (editModel.DepartmentId.HasValue && editModel.DepartmentId.Value > 0)
            {
                await LoadPositionsByDepartment(editModel.DepartmentId.Value);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task OnDepartmentChanged()
    {
        var deptId = editModel.DepartmentId;
        if (deptId.HasValue && deptId.Value > 0)
        {
            await LoadPositionsByDepartment(deptId.Value);
            editModel.PositionId = null;
        }
        else
        {
            availablePositions.Clear();
            editModel.PositionId = null;
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadPositionsByDepartment(int departmentId)
    {
        availablePositions = await OrgService.GetPositionsByDepartmentAsync(departmentId);
    }

    private async Task SaveUser()
    {
        errorMessage = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editModel.UserName))
        {
            errorMessage = "Логин обязателен";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editModel.SelectedRole))
        {
            errorMessage = "Необходимо выбрать роль";
            return;
        }

        if (editingUser == null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editModel.Password))
        {
            errorMessage = "Пароль обязателен для нового пользователя";
            return;
        }

        if (editModel.SelectedRole == "SuperAdmin")
        {
            errorMessage = "Назначение роли гл.администратора через этот интерфейс запрещено.";
            return;
        }

        // Для Employee не требуется обязательный выбор должности или отдела.
        // Отдел нужен только для фильтрации списка должностей, но не обязателен для сохранения.
        // Если должность не выбрана (PositionId == null) – это допустимо.

        try
        {
            if (editingUser == null)
            {
                // Создание нового пользователя
                var newUser = new ApplicationUser
                {
                    UserName = editModel.UserName,
                    Email = string.IsNullOrEmpty(editModel.Email) ? null : editModel.Email
                };

                var createResult = await UserManager.CreateAsync(newUser, editModel.Password);
                if (!createResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    errorMessage = string.Join(", ", createResult.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
                    return;
                }

                var roleResult = await UserManager.AddToRoleAsync(newUser, editModel.SelectedRole);
                if (!roleResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    errorMessage = string.Join(", ", roleResult.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
                    await UserManager.DeleteAsync(newUser);
                    return;
                }

                if (editModel.SelectedRole == "Employee")
                {
                    var employee = new Employee
                    {
                        UserId = newUser.Id,
                        FullName = editModel.FullName ?? editModel.UserName,
                        Email = newUser.Email
                    };
                    DbContext.Employees.Add(employee);
                    await DbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                    // PositionId может быть null
                    await OrgService.AssignEmployeeToPositionAsync(employee.Id, editModel.PositionId);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Редактирование существующего
                if (await IsSuperAdmin(editingUser))
                {
                    errorMessage = "Редактирование главного администратора запрещено";
                    return;
                }

                editingUser.UserName = editModel.UserName;
                editingUser.Email = string.IsNullOrEmpty(editModel.Email) ? null : editModel.Email;
                var updateResult = await UserManager.UpdateAsync(editingUser);
                if (!updateResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    errorMessage = string.Join(", ", updateResult.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
                    return;
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(editModel.Password))
                {
                    if (await UserManager.HasPasswordAsync(editingUser))
                        await UserManager.RemovePasswordAsync(editingUser);
                    var addPasswordResult = await UserManager.AddPasswordAsync(editingUser, editModel.Password);
                    if (!addPasswordResult.Succeeded)
                    {
                        errorMessage = string.Join(", ", addPasswordResult.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
                        return;
                    }
                }

                var currentRoles = await UserManager.GetRolesAsync(editingUser);
                if (currentRoles.FirstOrDefault() != editModel.SelectedRole)
                {
                    if (currentRoles.Any())
                        await UserManager.RemoveFromRolesAsync(editingUser, currentRoles);
                    await UserManager.AddToRoleAsync(editingUser, editModel.SelectedRole);
                }

                var existingEmployee = await DbContext.Employees.FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.UserId == editingUser.Id);
                if (editModel.SelectedRole == "Employee")
                {
                    if (existingEmployee == null)
                    {
                        existingEmployee = new Employee
                        {
                            UserId = editingUser.Id,
                            FullName = editModel.FullName ?? editingUser.UserName,
                            Email = editingUser.Email
                        };
                        DbContext.Employees.Add(existingEmployee);
                        await DbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        existingEmployee.FullName = editModel.FullName ?? existingEmployee.FullName;
                        existingEmployee.Email = editingUser.Email;
                        existingEmployee.IsActive = true;
                        await DbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }

                    var currentPosition = await DbContext.EmployeePositions
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ep => ep.EmployeeId == existingEmployee.Id && ep.EndDate == null);

                    if (currentPosition == null)
                    {
                        // PositionId может быть null
                        await OrgService.AssignEmployeeToPositionAsync(existingEmployee.Id, editModel.PositionId);
                    }
                    else if (currentPosition.PositionId != editModel.PositionId)
                    {
                        currentPosition.EndDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                        await OrgService.AssignEmployeeToPositionAsync(existingEmployee.Id, editModel.PositionId);
                    }
                }
                else if (existingEmployee != null)
                {
                    var positions = await DbContext.EmployeePositions.Where(ep => ep.EmployeeId == existingEmployee.Id).ToListAsync();
                    DbContext.EmployeePositions.RemoveRange(positions);
                    DbContext.Employees.Remove(existingEmployee);
                    await DbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                }
            }

            showModal = false;
            await LoadUsersOptimizedAsync();
            StateHasChanged();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = $"Ошибка сохранения пользователя: {ex.Message}";
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteUser(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        try
        {
            if (await IsSuperAdmin(user))
            {
                errorMessage = "Удаление главного администратора запрещено.";
                return;
            }

            // Запрос подтверждения
            var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", $"Вы уверены, что хотите удалить пользователя '{user.UserName}'?");
            if (!confirmed) return;

            var emp = await DbContext.Employees.FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.UserId == user.Id);
            if (emp != null)
            {
                var positions = await DbContext.EmployeePositions.Where(ep => ep.EmployeeId == emp.Id).ToListAsync();
                DbContext.EmployeePositions.RemoveRange(positions);
                DbContext.Employees.Remove(emp);
                await DbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
            }

            var result = await UserManager.DeleteAsync(user);
            if (result.Succeeded)
            {
                await LoadUsersOptimizedAsync();
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            else
            {
                errorMessage = string.Join(", ", result.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = $"Ошибка удаления пользователя: {ex.Message}";
        }
    }

    private async Task<bool> IsSuperAdmin(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        return await UserManager.IsInRoleAsync(user, "SuperAdmin");
    }

    private string TranslateRole(string roleEn) => roleEn switch
    {
        "Admin" => "Администратор",
        "Employee" => "Сотрудник",
        "SuperAdmin" => "Главный администратор",
        _ => roleEn
    };

    private void CloseModal()
    {
        showModal = false;
        editingUser = null;
        errorMessage = null;
        editModel = new UserEditModel();
        availablePositions.Clear();
    }

    public class UserEditModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Логин обязателен")]
        public string UserName { get; set; } = "";

        [EmailAddress(ErrorMessage = "Некорректный email")]
        public string? Email { get; set; }

        [DataType(DataType.Password)]
        public string Password { get; set; } = "";

        public string FullName { get; set; } = "";

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Роль обязательна")]
        public string SelectedRole { get; set; } = "";
        // для фильтрации списка должностей
        public int? DepartmentId { get; set; }   
        public int? PositionId { get; set; } 
    }
}

@using DocumEntum.Data

<li>
    <div class="department-item">
        <span style="cursor: pointer;" @onclick="ToggleChildren">
            @if (HasChildren)
            {
                @(Expanded ? "▼" : "▶")
            }
            else
            {
                <span style="visibility: hidden;">  </span>
            }
        </span>
        <span>@Department.Name</span>
        <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm ms-2">
            <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary" @onclick="() => OnEdit.InvokeAsync(Department)" title="Редактировать">✏️</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary" @onclick="() => OnAddChild.InvokeAsync(Department)" title="Добавить подотдел">➕</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-info" @onclick="() => OnManagePositions.InvokeAsync(Department)" title="Управление должностями">📋</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-danger" @onclick="() => OnDelete.InvokeAsync(Department)" title="Удалить">🗑️</button>
        </div>
    </div>
    @if (HasChildren && Expanded)
    {
        <ul>
            @foreach (var child in Children)
            {
                <DepartmentNode Department="child"
                                Children="child.Children?.ToList() ?? new List<Department>()"
                                OnEdit="OnEdit"
                                OnAddChild="OnAddChild"
                                OnManagePositions="OnManagePositions"
                                OnDelete="OnDelete" />
            }
        </ul>
    }
</li>

@code {
    [Parameter] public Department Department { get; set; } = default!;
    [Parameter] public List<Department> Children { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<Department> OnEdit { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<Department> OnAddChild { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<Department> OnManagePositions { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<Department> OnDelete { get; set; }

    private bool Expanded { get; set; } = true;
    private bool HasChildren => Children.Any();
    private void ToggleChildren() => Expanded = !Expanded;
}

--- Файл: DocumEntum\Components\Pages\Admin\Departments.razor ---
@page "/Admin/Departments"
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,SuperAdmin")]
@using DocumEntum.Data
@using DocumEntum.Services
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations
@inject IOrganizationService OrgService
@inject NavigationManager Nav
@inject IJSRuntime JS

<h3>Управление отделами</h3>

@if (isLoading)
{
    <p>Загрузка...</p>
}
else
{
    <button class="btn btn-primary mb-3" @onclick="() => OpenModal(null, null)">➕ Добавить корневой отдел</button>

    @if (rootDepartments.Any())
    {
        <ul class="department-tree">
            @foreach (var root in rootDepartments)
            {
                <DepartmentNode Department="root"
                                Children="root.Children?.ToList() ?? new List<Department>()"
                                OnEdit="(dept) => OpenModal(dept,null)"
                                OnAddChild="(dept) => OpenModal(null,dept)"
                                OnManagePositions="OpenPositionsModal"
                                OnDelete="ConfirmDelete" />
            }
        </ul>
    }
    else
    {
        <p>Нет отделов. Создайте первый отдел.</p>
    }
}

@if (showModal)

    <div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" style="background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
        <div class="modal-dialog">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">@(editingDepartment == null ? "Новый отдел" : "Редактирование отдела")</h5>

@* Модальное окно для добавления/редактирования должности *@

{

@code {
    private List<Department> allDepartmentsFlat = new();
    private List<Department> rootDepartments = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool showModal;
    private Department? editingDepartment;
    private Department? parentForNew;
    private DepartmentEditModel editModel = new();
    private string? errorMessage;

    // Переменные для управления должностями
    private bool showPositionsModal;
    private bool isLoadingPositions;
    private Department? selectedDepartment;
    private List<Position> departmentPositions = new();
    private bool showPositionEditModal;
    private Position? editingPosition;
    private PositionEditModel positionEditModel = new();
    private string? positionErrorMessage;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        isLoading = true;
        try
        {
            allDepartmentsFlat = await OrgService.GetAllDepartmentsFlatAsync();
            BuildTree();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = $"Ошибка загрузки: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void BuildTree()
    {
        var lookup = allDepartmentsFlat.ToDictionary(d => d.Id);
        foreach (var dept in allDepartmentsFlat)
        {
            dept.Children = new List<Department>();
        }
        rootDepartments.Clear();
        foreach (var dept in allDepartmentsFlat)
        {
            if (dept.ParentId == null)
                rootDepartments.Add(dept);
            else if (lookup.TryGetValue(dept.ParentId.Value, out var parent))
                parent.Children.Add(dept);
        }
    }

    private void OpenModal(Department? editDept, Department? parent)
    {
        editingDepartment = editDept;
        parentForNew = parent;
        editModel = new DepartmentEditModel();

        if (editDept != null)
        {
            editModel.Name = editDept.Name;
            editModel.ParentId = editDept.ParentId;
        }
        else
        {
            editModel.ParentId = parent?.Id;
        }

        showModal = true;
        errorMessage = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task SaveDepartment()
    {
        errorMessage = null;

        try
        {
            if (editingDepartment == null)
            {
                var newDept = new Department
                {
                    Name = editModel.Name,
                    ParentId = editModel.ParentId
                };
                await OrgService.CreateDepartmentAsync(newDept.Name, newDept.ParentId);
            }
            else
            {
                if (editModel.ParentId == editingDepartment.Id)
                {
                    errorMessage = "Отдел не может быть родителем самого себя.";
                    return;
                }
                if (editModel.ParentId.HasValue && IsDescendantOf(editModel.ParentId.Value, editingDepartment.Id))
                {
                    errorMessage = "Нельзя переместить отдел в его собственный подотдел.";
                    return;
                }

                editingDepartment.Name = editModel.Name;
                editingDepartment.ParentId = editModel.ParentId;
                await OrgService.UpdateDepartmentAsync(editingDepartment);
            }

            await LoadData();
            CloseModal();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage = $"Ошибка сохранения: {ex.Message}";
        }
    }

    private async Task ConfirmDelete(Department dept)
    {
        var canDelete = await OrgService.CanDeleteDepartmentAsync(dept.Id);
        if (!canDelete)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Невозможно удалить отдел. У него есть подотделы, документы или сотрудники на должностях.");
            return;
        }

        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", $"Удалить отдел '{dept.Name}'?");
        if (confirmed)
        {
            await OrgService.DeleteDepartmentAsync(dept.Id);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }


    private bool IsDescendantOf(int possibleDescendantId, int ancestorId)
    {
        var current = allDepartmentsFlat.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Id == possibleDescendantId);
        while (current != null && current.ParentId != null)
        {
            if (current.ParentId == ancestorId) return true;
            current = allDepartmentsFlat.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Id == current.ParentId);
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void CloseModal()
    {
        showModal = false;
        editingDepartment = null;
        parentForNew = null;
        editModel = new DepartmentEditModel();
        errorMessage = null;
    }

    // ========== Управление должностями ==========
    private async Task OpenPositionsModal(Department dept)
    {
        selectedDepartment = dept;
        showPositionsModal = true;
        await LoadPositions();
    }

    private async Task LoadPositions()
    {
        if (selectedDepartment == null) return;
        isLoadingPositions = true;
        try
        {
            departmentPositions = await OrgService.GetPositionsByDepartmentAsync(selectedDepartment.Id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            positionErrorMessage = $"Ошибка загрузки должностей: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoadingPositions = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void OpenPositionEditModal(Position? pos)
    {
        editingPosition = pos;
        positionEditModel = new PositionEditModel();
        if (pos != null)
        {
            positionEditModel.Title = pos.Title;
            positionEditModel.Description = pos.Description;
        }
        showPositionEditModal = true;
        positionErrorMessage = null;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task SavePosition()
    {
        positionErrorMessage = null;
        try
        {
            if (selectedDepartment == null) return;

            if (editingPosition == null)
            {
                await OrgService.CreatePositionAsync(selectedDepartment.Id, positionEditModel.Title, positionEditModel.Description);
            }
            else
            {
                editingPosition.Title = positionEditModel.Title;
                editingPosition.Description = positionEditModel.Description;
                await OrgService.UpdatePositionAsync(editingPosition);
            }
            await LoadPositions();
            ClosePositionEditModal();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            positionErrorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async Task ConfirmDeletePosition(Position pos)
    {
        var canDelete = await OrgService.CanDeletePositionAsync(pos.Id);
        if (!canDelete)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Нельзя удалить должность, на которую назначены сотрудники.");
            return;
        }

        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", $"Удалить должность '{pos.Title}'?");
        if (confirmed)
        {
            await OrgService.DeletePositionAsync(pos.Id);
            await LoadPositions();
        }
    }

    private void ClosePositionsModal()
    {
        showPositionsModal = false;
        selectedDepartment = null;
        departmentPositions.Clear();
        positionErrorMessage = null;
    }

    private void ClosePositionEditModal()
    {
        showPositionEditModal = false;
        editingPosition = null;
        positionEditModel = new PositionEditModel();
        positionErrorMessage = null;
    }

    // ========== Вспомогательные модели ==========
    public class DepartmentEditModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Название обязательно")]
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public int? ParentId { get; set; }
    }

    public class PositionEditModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Название обязательно")]
        public string Title { get; set; } = "";
        public string? Description { get; set; }
    }
}

@code {
    private List<Position> positions = new();
    private List<Department> departments = new();
    private List<Employee> employees = new();
    private List<Employee> availableEmployees = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;

    // Модалка для должности
    private bool showPositionModal = false;
    private Position? editingPosition = null;
    private PositionEditModel positionEditModel = new();
    private string? positionErrorMessage;

    // Модалка для назначения сотрудника
    private bool showAssignModal = false;
    private Position? selectedPosition = null;
    private int selectedEmployeeId;
    private string? assignErrorMessage;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        try
        {
            isLoading = true;
            positions = await OrgService.GetAllPositionsWithDetailsAsync();
            departments = await OrgService.GetAllDepartmentsFlatAsync();
            employees = await OrgService.GetAllEmployeesAsync();
            availableEmployees = await OrgService.GetAvailableEmployeesAsync();
            // Подгружаем связанных пользователей для отображения логина
            foreach (var emp in employees)
            {
                // Если нужно отобразить UserName, можно предварительно загрузить, но Employee.User загружен?
                // В методе GetAllEmployeesAsync нет Include(User). Можно либо добавить Include, либо не отображать.
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            positionErrorMessage = $"Ошибка загрузки: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void OpenPositionModal(Position? pos)
    {
        editingPosition = pos;
        positionEditModel = new PositionEditModel();
        if (pos != null)
        {
            positionEditModel.Title = pos.Title;
            positionEditModel.Description = pos.Description;
            positionEditModel.DepartmentId = pos.DepartmentId;
        }
        showPositionModal = true;
        positionErrorMessage = null;
    }

    private async Task SavePosition()
    {
        positionErrorMessage = null;
        try
        {
            if (positionEditModel.DepartmentId == null || positionEditModel.DepartmentId == 0)
                throw new Exception("Необходимо выбрать отдел.");

            if (editingPosition == null)
            {
                await OrgService.CreatePositionAsync(positionEditModel.DepartmentId.Value, positionEditModel.Title, positionEditModel.Description);
            }
            else
            {
                editingPosition.Title = positionEditModel.Title;
                editingPosition.Description = positionEditModel.Description;
                editingPosition.DepartmentId = positionEditModel.DepartmentId.Value;
                await OrgService.UpdatePositionAsync(editingPosition);
            }
            await LoadData();
            ClosePositionModal();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            positionErrorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async Task DeletePosition(Position pos)
    {
        bool canDelete = await OrgService.CanDeletePositionAsync(pos.Id);
        if (!canDelete)
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("alert", "Нельзя удалить должность, на которую назначены сотрудники.");
            return;
        }

        bool confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", $"Удалить должность '{pos.Title}'?");
        if (confirmed)
        {
            await OrgService.DeletePositionAsync(pos.Id);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private void ClosePositionModal()
    {
        showPositionModal = false;
        editingPosition = null;
        positionEditModel = new PositionEditModel();
        positionErrorMessage = null;
    }

    private void OpenAssignModal(Position pos)
    {
        selectedPosition = pos;
        selectedEmployeeId = 0;
        assignErrorMessage = null;
        showAssignModal = true;
    }

    private async Task AssignEmployee()
    {
        if (selectedEmployeeId == 0)
        {
            assignErrorMessage = "Выберите сотрудника.";
            return;
        }
        if (selectedPosition == null) return;

        try
        {
            await OrgService.AssignEmployeeToPositionAsync(selectedEmployeeId, selectedPosition.Id);
            await LoadData();
            CloseAssignModal();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            assignErrorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async Task UnassignEmployee(int employeePositionId)
    {
        bool confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", "Открепить сотрудника от должности?");
        if (confirmed)
        {
            await OrgService.RemoveEmployeeFromPositionAsync(employeePositionId);
            await LoadData();
        }
    }

    private void CloseAssignModal()
    {
        showAssignModal = false;
        selectedPosition = null;
        selectedEmployeeId = 0;
        assignErrorMessage = null;
    }

    public class PositionEditModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Название обязательно")]
        public string Title { get; set; } = "";

        public string? Description { get; set; }

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Отдел обязателен")]
        public int? DepartmentId { get; set; }
    }
